$doc: Vyomi capability registry — Azure Event Grid. See aws/s3.json for the contract. 'nano' = Nano/dev_server (core/azure_arm_core.py + core/azure_eventgrid_core.py); 'offline' = the appliance (providers/azure_services.py), which has the generic ARM topic catalog but no event-subscription engine yet.

azure.eventgrid.topics.crud.title: Topics — create, list, get, update, delete (generic ARM catalog)

azure.eventgrid.topics.listactions.title: "Open query" (Azure Resource Graph Explorer) and "Assign tags" bulk action on the Topics list
limitations: Azure Resource Graph and bulk tag assignment across resources are not modeled.

azure.eventgrid.eventsubscriptions.crud.title: Event subscriptions on a topic — create, list, get, update, delete (destination, filters)
limitations: The appliance (offline substrate) does not yet implement the Microsoft.EventGrid/eventSubscriptions extension resource; only Nano and the dev server do.

azure.eventgrid.eventsubscriptions.deliv.title: Dead-lettering and retry policy (max delivery attempts, event TTL, expiration time)
limitations: Vyomi stores and returns these settings exactly as configured (PUT/GET round-trip), but never enforces them — see azure.eventgrid.eventsubscriptions.delivery.

azure.eventgrid.eventsubscriptions.deliv.title: Event delivery (filter matching, pushing to the destination endpoint, retries, dead-lettering)
limitations: Vyomi stores topics and event subscriptions and returns them over the native ARM wire, but there is no publish/delivery runtime: no event is ever matched against a subscription's filters, pushed to its destination, retried, or dead-lettered.

azure.eventgrid.hub.namespaces.title: Namespaces (MQTT broker)
limitations: Event Grid namespaces and the MQTT broker are out of scope for this release.

azure.eventgrid.hub.systemtopics.title: System topics (Azure service events)
limitations: System topics for other Azure services' events are out of scope for this release.

azure.eventgrid.hub.domains.title: Domains
limitations: Event Grid domains are out of scope for this release.

azure.eventgrid.hub.partnerevents.title: Partner events (partner configurations, partner topics, partner registrations, partner namespaces)
limitations: Partner Events is out of scope for this release.

azure.eventgrid.topic.activitylog.title: Topic activity log
limitations: The ARM activity log (control-plane audit trail) is not modeled.

azure.eventgrid.topic.iam.title: Access control (IAM) on a topic
limitations: Role assignments scoped to an individual resource are not modeled.

azure.eventgrid.topic.locks.title: Resource locks
limitations: Management locks (CanNotDelete / ReadOnly) are not modeled.

azure.eventgrid.topic.monitoring.title: Alerts, metrics, diagnostic settings and logs on a topic
limitations: Metrics charts, alert rules, diagnostic-setting log routing and Log Analytics queries are not modeled.

azure.eventgrid.topic.tools.title: Diagnose and solve problems, Tasks, and Support + Troubleshooting
limitations: These portal troubleshooting and support tools are not modeled.

azure.eventgrid.topic.exporttemplate.title: Export template (ARM template / Bicep / Terraform)
limitations: Generating an exportable ARM/Bicep/Terraform template for a resource is not modeled.
